{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [255:0] local_winner;
        wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];
        genvar g, j, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            if (g == 15) begin : highest_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : highest_local
                    assign local_winner[g*16+j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j];
                end else begin : lower_local
                    assign local_winner[g*16+j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j] &
                        ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_position
                    assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);
                end else begin : selected_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                        local_winner[g*16+j] & group_enable[g];
                end
            end

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : local_encode
                localparam [15:0] MASK = b == 0 ? 16'hAAAA :
                                            b == 1 ? 16'hCCCC :
                                            b == 2 ? 16'hF0F0 : 16'hFF00;
                assign low_terms[b][g] = group_enable[g] &
                    (|(local_winner[g*16 +: 16] & MASK));
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_outputs
            localparam [15:0] MASK = b == 0 ? 16'hAAAA :
                                        b == 1 ? 16'hCCCC :
                                        b == 2 ? 16'hF0F0 : 16'hFF00;
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
            assign output_encoded[b+4] = |(group_winner & MASK);
        end
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : original_parameter_behavior
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : high_first
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : high_first
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original one-hot outputs depend on the complete recursive priority encoding followed by binary-to-one-hot decoding. The reported critical path also contains heavily loaded intermediate encoding logic.",
  "rewrite": "Use sixteen parallel 16-bit priority groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion independently, then generate one-hot outputs directly. Encode the low four bits through group-local reductions and the upper four bits from group winners, avoiding the encode-then-decode path.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The direct one-hot paths and parallel group encoding should reduce maximum arrival relative to the 2.60 ns baseline. No mapped timing measurement is available for this candidate; the gain and zero electrical violations require confirmation in the specified flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Additional local winner and group-exclusion logic replaces the recursive mux encoder and global decoder. Shared group reductions and local encoding limit duplication. Mapped area, compliance with the 8862.124480 um2 cap, and buffering costs remain unmeasured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the assessed instance, the highest asserted input bit wins for every binary input combination. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, exactly as the original. Module ports and parameter declarations/defaults are preserved; other parameter configurations retain the original implementation. The design is entirely combinational with no undefined outputs or environmental assumptions."
}
